text: Once upon a time, a little fox found a bright red lantern beside the river.
The fox carried the lantern home and shared its warm light with three friends.
A small blue bird sang in the old oak tree while rain tapped on every leaf.
Mina opened the wooden gate, waved to her brother, and ran toward the garden.
The garden had yellow flowers, green grass, smooth stones, and one sleepy rabbit.
